label: November 10
title: The Life Church Begins Weekly Services
paragraph: The Life Church Memphis officially began its journey with regular weekly services, establishing a foundation for spiritual growth and community impact.

label: Summer
title: First Ever Missions Team Sent to Nairobi, Kenya
paragraph: Demonstrating early commitment to global outreach, The Life Church sent its first missions team to Nairobi, Kenya, beginning years of international service.

label: Spring
title: Leased First Permanent Office Space in Cordova
paragraph: The Life Church leased its first permanent office space in Cordova, giving the growing ministry a home base of its own.

label: Fall
title: Leased First Billboard on Germantown Parkway
paragraph: Billboard on Germantown Parkway in front of the Homebuilders Association building — the first campaign: Touching Our City, Reaching the World.

label: October 28
title: Celebrated 5 Years as a Church
paragraph: The Life Church marked a significant milestone, celebrating five years of ministry and spiritual impact in the Memphis area.

label: March 31
title: First Service at Our Own Building on Germantown Parkway
paragraph: A pivotal moment in the church's history as it moved into its first owned building, providing a dedicated space for worship and ministry.

label: September 22
title: Hosted Reinhard Bonnke For Special Miracle Sunday Service
paragraph: The Life Church hosted evangelist Reinhard Bonnke for a special miracle service, bringing powerful ministry to the congregation.

label: Spring
title: Axis Student Ministries Launches
paragraph: The Life Church launched Axis Student Ministries, creating a dedicated space for the next generation to grow in faith and leadership.

label: Spring
title: Launched Zoe Women's Ministry
paragraph: A dedicated ministry for women was established, creating a space for spiritual growth, fellowship, and support among the women of The Life Church.

label: Fall
title: Launched First Year of Life Church Internship Program
paragraph: Recognizing the importance of developing young leaders, The Life Church established its internship program to mentor and train the next generation of ministry leaders.

label: September
title: Canceled Sunday Services to Serve Hurricane Katrina Victims
paragraph: Demonstrating Christ-like compassion, The Life Church prioritized serving Hurricane Katrina victims over regular services, mobilizing volunteers and resources for disaster relief.

label: Spring
title: Launched Vision Partners Ministry
paragraph: A new ministry was established to engage members in strategic partnership for church growth and kingdom impact.

label: March 6–7
title: Hosted First Make Room Event
paragraph: The Life Church launched its signature Make Room event, creating a powerful experience focused on creating space for God's work in attendees' lives.

label: Early
title: Launched TV Program
paragraph: Extending its reach beyond the sanctuary, The Life Church began broadcasting services on television, bringing ministry to thousands of homes.

label: Early
title: Launched Collierville Location at YMCA
paragraph: The Life Church expanded its presence in the Memphis area by opening a second campus location in Collierville at the YMCA.

label: July 13–16
title: Hosted First Axis Conference
paragraph: Launching an annual tradition, The Life Church began hosting the Axis Conference, a gathering focused on equipping and inspiring church leaders.

label: Fall
title: Launched Feed Memphis Outreach
paragraph: Demonstrating commitment to community needs, The Life Church launched Feed Memphis, an ongoing outreach program to combat food insecurity.

label: February 9
title: Launched East Memphis Location at the Malco Paradiso
paragraph: The Life Church expanded its reach with a new campus in East Memphis at the Malco Paradiso theater, bringing convenient access to ministry across the city.

label: May 25
title: Launched The Life Church Santiago Location
paragraph: Taking the gospel internationally, The Life Church opened its first international campus in Santiago, expanding its global kingdom impact.

label: September 18–20
title: Hosted First Zoe Conference
paragraph: The Life Church launched the Zoe Conference, a gathering dedicated to women's ministry and spiritual growth.

label: August
title: Started the Read to Lead After-School Program
paragraph: Investing in the community's youth, The Life Church established an after-school program focused on literacy and leadership development.

label: December
title: Hosted First Sound of Christmas
paragraph: The Life Church launched an annual Christmas celebration featuring worship and community fellowship, becoming a beloved holiday tradition.

label: May
title: Broke Ground on new Houston Levee Facility
paragraph: Marking a major expansion, The Life Church began construction on a new state-of-the-art facility on Houston Levee, designed to better serve the growing congregation.

label: September 9–10
title: Houston Levee Auditorium Grand Opening
paragraph: The newly constructed Houston Levee facility officially opened, providing an impressive venue for worship, conferences, and community events.

label: April 21
title: Launched the Austin Peay Location
paragraph: Continuing its expansion, The Life Church opened another Memphis-area campus at Austin Peay, extending ministry accessibility.

label: Summer
title: Sent a Record 21 Mission Teams on Trips Around the World
paragraph: Demonstrating unprecedented global engagement, The Life Church deployed 21 mission teams worldwide, impacting communities across multiple continents.
stat: 21 teams sent in a single summer

label: April 12
title: Launched The Life Church — New York
paragraph: Taking the gospel to the East Coast, The Life Church established a campus in New York, marking significant national expansion.

label: September
title: Leadership in Black and White Podcast Launches
paragraph: The Life Church launched the Leadership in Black and White podcast, extending its voice on leadership beyond the walls of the church.

label: October 17
title: Launched The Life Church — Massachusetts
paragraph: Expanding further northeast, The Life Church opened a campus in Massachusetts, continuing strategic national growth.

label: November 10
title: Celebrated Our 25th Anniversary
paragraph: The Life Church marked a quarter-century of ministry with celebration and gratitude for 25 years of spiritual impact and growth.

label: January 30
title: Launched The Life Church — Italy
paragraph: Expanding into Europe, The Life Church established a campus in Italy, bringing gospel ministry to the Mediterranean region.

label: June
title: Axis Conference Sells Out for the First Time
paragraph: The Axis Conference reached full capacity for the first time, demonstrating its growing impact and influence in church leadership development.
stat: Sold out for the first time

label: March 19
title: Launched The Life Church — DC Metro
paragraph: Extending ministry to the nation's capital, The Life Church opened a campus serving the Washington DC metropolitan area.

label: March 20–21
title: Hosted First International Make Room Conference
paragraph: Taking its signature Make Room event global, The Life Church hosted the first international edition, impacting leaders worldwide.

label: January
title: Hosted First Revival Nights
paragraph: The Life Church launched Revival Nights, a new series of events dedicated to spiritual renewal and deep worship experiences.

label: March 3
title: Launched The Life Church — South Africa
paragraph: Extending gospel impact to the African continent, The Life Church established a campus in South Africa.

label: March 31
title: Launched Our First Prison Location at Shelby County Division of Corrections
paragraph: Demonstrating ministry to the marginalized, The Life Church established a campus serving inmates at the Shelby County Division of Corrections.

label: June
title: Axis Worship Debuts First Original Song
paragraph: Axis Worship released its first original composition, marking a creative milestone in the music ministry.

label: September 8
title: Launched The Life Church — Nashville
paragraph: Bringing ministry to Tennessee's capital, The Life Church opened a campus in Nashville.

label: February 23
title: Launched Second Prison Location at 201 Poplar
paragraph: Expanding prison ministry, The Life Church established a second location serving inmates at the 201 Poplar facility.

label: August 8
title: Broke Ground on the Global Hub & Next Generation Building
paragraph: The Life Church began construction on a Global Hub and Next Generation Building, signifying continued expansion and vision for the future.

label: September 1
title: Launched The Life Leadership Bible School
paragraph: The Life Church launched an educational initiative dedicated to training spiritual leaders through intensive Bible study and ministry preparation.
